messages:
Samir K.: Customer on-host reported 400 from /v1/tool-call, error: JSON decode failed for tool args. Repro attached.
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool-call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "tool": "file.write",
    "args": "{\"path\":\"/tmp/report.txt\", \"comment\":\"Line1\nLine2\", }"
  }'
```
Response: 400 {"error":"invalid_tool_args","message":"Invalid JSON in 'args': 'Unescaped control char at pos 48' or 'Trailing comma at pos 76'"}

Ashwin P.: Can you paste the exact body the SDK sent? Is this raw model output or our serialization?
Samir K.: Looks like SDK forwarded model text as raw string into args. Customer's model output included an actual newline and ended with a trailing comma. Example from logs:
```json
"{\"path\":\"/tmp/report.txt\", \"comment\":\"Line1\nLine2\", }"
```
Lena H.: Likely root: LLM produced a JSON-like string with an embedded newline and trailing comma. SDK currently trusts model text and inserts into tool call verbatim. :grimacing: 
Lena H.: Quick repro locally:
```bash
python -c 'print("{\"a\":\"1\n2\",}")'
# -> prints invalid JSON when wrapped into args
```
Support Bot: Incident created INC-4729: mark as "tool-args-parse-failure". Adding customer id 98765 and example payload.
OpsJen: Short-term: add sanitizer to SDK that attempts json.loads on model text; if it fails, try:
- strip trailing commas (regex)
- replace literal newlines with \n- run json.loads again
I'll open PR to patch SDK in next hour.
Ashwin P.: Also add a warning log when sanitizer mutates model output so we can surface to evaluation team.
Samir K.: Will send customer workaround: manually escape newlines ("\n") and remove trailing commas in tool args. I'll attach a sample fixed payload to the ticket.
Samir K.: Thanks, folks — escalating to eng-runtime if PR needs infra review.
